presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, title, references, four long pieces, a long substituted value, long scenario labels and captions, four shared facts. coordinator decision 2026-09-26: field labels (40/40/31/42 → 16/15/18/20 characters), piece values (52/39/33/35 → 24/16/26/25), the different piece (39 → 16) and the reply references (19 → 15) are capped so the reply scenes fit at 16 px; at 1:1 the pieces are drawn in full once on the offer and the reply copies carry number tokens (coordinator decision 2026-09-26, LAW-0135 precedent); all stay longer than baseline, 4 terms and 4 shared facts kept; the scenario texts, shared facts and notes keep their near-maximum length (the title, names, roles and changed fact are capped as recorded next). coordinator decision 2026-09-26 (standing stress cap rule, as for LAW-0448 round 5): the offer title (76 → 42 characters), the party names (40/30 → 26/21) and roles (40/33 → 29/22) and the changed fact (101 → 70) are capped so Party A keeps a full-size figure with a head ≥ 48 px at 1:1; every field stays longer than baseline and every count is kept.
